title: American Airlines May Hire A CEO Successor To Robert Isom Before End Of Year — Its Best Outside Candidate Is At Southwest
summary: Scott McCartney hears American wants to bring in an outsider as president and Robert Isom’s heir apparent. Southwest’s Andrew Watterson makes sense. But American already has a Delta veteran doing much of the job, and hiring over Nat Pieper could cost them.

title: American Airlines Pilot Received A Cockpit Alert — An Air Traffic Control Says They’ve “Had Alien Sightings Out There”
summary: A pilot flying from Washington National airport to Philadelphia for American Airlines subsidiary PSA got a cockpit traffic alert near Baltimore. The air traffic controller told him he’d already passed the only airplane she could see nearby. Then she added, “I mean, we have had alien sightings out there, so…”

title: American Airlines Pilots And Flight Attendants Unite To Demand New Leadership—Say They’re Done Asking Management To Do Better
summary: Five days after American Airlines announced it was replacing Chief Operating Officer, the flight attendants and pilots unions say that change at the top needs to go further. And they’re making this case in part based on American’s poor recovery from this month’s FAA nationwide ground stop.

title: Bilt Palladium Is My Best Card For Everyday Spending—Get It By December 31 To Lock In Its Most Valuable Rewards
summary: Bilt Palladium gets most of my everyday spending. My wife and I used the card’s 4% Bilt Cash to earn 3 points per dollar on $50,000 in purchases this year. Bilt is phasing out that 4% earning option, and if you want the choice to keep it, you need to apply, get approved and accept the card by December 31. Already have the card? You still need to opt in before your first card anniversary in 2027.
